faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

0.question: Is Vetolib compliant with UAE VAT regulations?
0.answer: Yes. Every invoice includes automatic 5% VAT calculation and your clinic's Tax Registration Number (TRN), as required by the Federal Tax Authority (FTA).

1.question: Can I use Vetolib in Arabic?
1.answer: Absolutely. Vetolib is fully bilingual English/Arabic with complete RTL (right-to-left) support. You can switch languages at any time.

2.question: How is my clinic data secured?
2.answer: Each clinic's data is completely isolated (multi-tenant architecture). No other clinic can ever see your patients, records, or invoices. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

3.question: What roles can I assign to my team?
3.answer: Four roles: Admin (full access + team management), Vet (clinical + billing), Assistant (read-only medical records), Receptionist (appointments + billing only, no medical records).

4.question: Can I import my existing patient data?
4.answer: Yes. We provide CSV import tools and our onboarding team can assist with data migration from your existing system.

5.question: Is there a mobile app?
5.answer: Vetolib is a responsive web application that works on any device — desktop, tablet, or phone — through your browser. No app installation required.

6.question: What happens after the free trial?
6.answer: After 14 days, you choose a plan or your account is paused (not deleted). Your data is preserved for 90 days so you can reactivate anytime.

7.question: Do you offer training?
7.answer: All plans include access to our help center and video tutorials. Pro and Enterprise plans include live onboarding sessions with our team.

consent.title: Messaging Terms & Conditions
consent.intro: Before sending a message to the clinic, please read and accept the following terms.
consent.terms_body:
By using this messaging portal, you agree that:

• Messages are monitored by clinic staff during business hours (Sunday–Thursday 08:00–20:00, Friday 08:00–12:00).
• This service is not a substitute for emergency veterinary care. In case of a life-threatening situation, contact an emergency clinic immediately.
• You may receive up to 5 messages per day through this portal.
• Messages and attachments are stored securely and used only to provide veterinary care.
• You may request an export of your conversations at any time.
consent.accept_label: I accept the messaging terms and conditions
consent.must_accept: You must accept the terms to continue.
